inferTasksFromScripts.title: inferTasksFromScripts
inferTasksFromScripts.description: Automatically infer moon tasks from package.json scripts or deno.json tasks. Some caveats to be aware of:  - Lifecycle (pre, post) scripts are not inferred. - Outputs will be automatically detected (if possible). - Script names that contain : will be converted to -. - Script names that contain dev, start, serve, or preview will be considered local only.
inferTasksFromScripts.markdownDescription: Automatically infer moon tasks from `package.json` scripts or `deno.json` tasks. Some caveats to be aware of:  - Lifecycle (pre, post) scripts are not inferred. - Outputs will be automatically detected (if possible). - Script names that contain `:` will be converted to `-`. - Script names that contain `dev`, `start`, `serve`, or `preview` will be considered local only.

rootPackageDependenciesOnly.markdownDescription: Enforces that only the root `package.json` can be used for dependencies, which supports the "one version policy" pattern.

includeSharedTypes.title: includeSharedTypes
includeSharedTypes.description: Appends shared types to include in tsconfig.json, for each project. If the shared types are a project and syncProjectReferences is enabled, they will also be synced as a project reference.  Shared types must exist in a "types" folder, relative from the configured root.
includeSharedTypes.markdownDescription: Appends shared types to `include` in `tsconfig.json`, for each project. If the shared types are a project and `syncProjectReferences` is enabled, they will also be synced as a project reference.  Shared types must exist in a "types" folder, relative from the configured `root`.

pruneProjectReferences.markdownDescription: Prunes synced project `references` in `tsconfig.json` when they are no longer needed. When enabled, existing references are treated as moon-managed and may be removed during sync.
